kuk-swamp.name: Kuk Swamp
kuk-swamp.summary: Archaeological site in the Papua New Guinea highlands where evidence shows farming, including taro, developed independently starting about 9,000 years ago.

sago.name: Sago
sago.summary: A starch extracted from the core of tropical palms, a traditional staple food across island Southeast Asia and Melanesia, especially important to Malaysia's Melanau people.

canarium-indicum.name: Canarium indicum
canarium-indicum.summary: A tree native to eastern Melanesia, also called the galip nut, valued for food, timber and traditional medicine.

karuka.name: Karuka
karuka.summary: A species of pandanus tree bearing a highly nutritious nut, a major food crop in the New Guinea highlands, prized enough that villagers relocate near the trees at harvest time.
